cycles.review: Start panel still used a vertical goal, small item and small close target; later levels retained a legacy downward offset.
cycles.changes: Horizontal 140px goal artwork and 62px count, Lora title, 82px close control with 104px target, bounded hard-level badge, centered folio.
cycles.verified: Built and visually checked the level-one briefing.

cycles.review: Three targets crowded the energy region and left the right side empty; completed goals allocated repeated checks.
cycles.changes: Distribute goals across the full HUD well, fit 4-digit energy, reuse completion checks and restore a positive counter cleanly.
cycles.verified: Three-goal visual check, 100-refresh regression and hero-ability checks passed.

cycles.review: Reward star was stretched and used a mismatched backing; energy icon and count were cramped.
cycles.changes: Preserved star aspect ratio, matched backing silhouette, moved the cat clear of rewards, increased energy spacing and guarded delayed entrance callbacks.
cycles.verified: Built; sapphire reward and goal regressions passed; visually checked all 12 stars and the gem reward.

cycles.review: Shop descriptions touched the right border, item levels crowded portraits, and prices were off-center.
cycles.changes: Taller 448px cards, left-aligned descriptions, a separate level row, centered full-width prices, larger info targets and responsive two-row spacing.
cycles.verified: Built and visually checked all four cards on a phone; moved level captions clear of the painted fold.

cycles.review: On a compact phone the tutorial character crossed the painted parchment edge, despite fitting the texture rectangle.
cycles.changes: Inset the character from the visible frame and added a dark, independently centered OK caption. Increased top text inset and reserved the full icon-row gap for three-line hints.
cycles.verified: Built and visually checked the level-two tutorial on 360x640; all 19 behavior checks passed. Final production build checked automatic tutorials at levels 2 and 15; the 15th-level menu also survived 80 UI inputs with one menu instance.
